stella-osoba.bio:
Stella Osoba is a Senior Editor, Trading and Investing at Imperialpedia, as well as an attorney, financial writer, technical analyst, and independent trader. She has extensive experience covering financial markets, trading, investing, technical analysis, behavioral finance, and risk management.

Osoba began her professional career in law before moving into financial writing, trading, and technical analysis. Her work has appeared in publications including Technical Analysis of Stocks & Commodities and The Journal of Technical Analysis, as well as financial websites such as GOBankingRates and TradersAdvantage.

She is a Chartered Market Technician (CMT) and has been actively involved with the CMT Association. She has served in leadership roles within Women in Technical Analysis and has contributed to educational initiatives, including the development of materials for the CMT examination. She has also served as a grader for the CMT Level III examination and has taught and mentored traders and financial professionals.

Osoba’s areas of expertise include technical analysis, trading strategies, financial markets, behavioral finance, risk management, market history, and investment analysis. Her background in law and financial markets provides an interdisciplinary perspective on trading, investing, and financial decision-making.

chip-stapleton.bio:
Chip Stapleton is a financial analyst with professional experience in financial planning, wealth management, corporate finance, investment analysis, and business exit planning.

Stapleton spent approximately eight years working in finance, with much of his career focused on financial planning and wealth management. As a financial advisor, he worked with individuals and businesses to develop strategies for achieving financial goals. His experience includes case design, investment analysis, investment recommendations, portfolio construction, asset management, financial statement analysis, business planning, and business exit strategies.

Stapleton later transitioned into financial analysis, where his work involves analyzing, modeling, and projecting personal and business financial statements. His focus includes helping companies maximize transferable value and assisting business owners with planning for successful exits.

He holds Series 7 and Series 66 securities licenses and an Indiana Life, Accident, and Health Insurance License. He has also pursued the Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) program.

Stapleton’s academic background combines music, physics, and technology. He earned a bachelor’s degree in Saxophone and Physics from Indiana University’s Jacobs School of Music and a master’s degree in Music Technology from Indiana University–Purdue University Indianapolis.

His interdisciplinary background in mathematics, analytical thinking, finance, and business strategy informs his approach to financial analysis and investment-related topics.

dara-abasi-ita.bio:
Dara-Abasi Ita is a financial writer and editor whose work focuses on investing, trading, global markets, and financial technology.

Ita began his writing career as a member of the editorial board of a student newsletter at the University of Uyo, where he researched and wrote about financial topics including mergers and acquisitions. He later became an editor for Lawverse magazine, a publication focused on legal careers and education.

In 2020, Ita launched a personal blog covering topics including private equity, asset management, international payments, and risk management. In 2022, he joined blockchain services platform SweetBlocks as a technical writer and decentralized finance analyst, expanding his work into blockchain and financial technology.

He subsequently wrote for Investing.com, covering global markets, trading, and investing, and has contributed more than 20 articles to the publication. He is also a writer for Imperialpedia, where his work covers financial markets and investment-related topics.

Ita studied law at the University of Uyo, combining his legal education with professional interests in finance, investing, trading, and emerging financial technologies.

robert-kelly.bio:
Robert Kelly is Managing Director of XTS Energy LLC and an experienced energy industry executive with more than three decades of experience in corporate leadership, energy development, investment, and capital formation.

Throughout his career, Kelly has been involved in the development of renewable energy and natural gas projects. He was a founding member of DKRW Energy LLC, where he co-led the development of more than 900 megawatts of wind energy. Earlier in his career, while serving as a senior executive at a major energy company, he founded a wind energy company that later became GE Wind Energy. He also helped establish a solar energy company through a joint venture with Amoco that became part of BP Solar.

Kelly has extensive experience in energy investment and project development. He has served as commercial lead or co-lead in raising more than $4.5 billion in capital from private equity investors, strategic investors, and commercial banks for energy projects.

He has also held senior leadership positions in the energy sector, including serving as chair of Mexico Pacific Limited, LLC, which is developing a large-scale liquefied natural gas project on Mexico’s Pacific Coast.

Kelly holds a bachelor’s degree in nuclear engineering from the U.S. Military Academy at West Point, a Master of Public Administration from Harvard Kennedy School, and a Ph.D. in Economics from Harvard University. He also serves as an Executive Professor at the Mays Business School at Texas A&M University.

julius-mansa.bio:
Julius Mansa is a finance and operations professional, educator, and researcher. He has more than 15 years of experience in financial management, corporate finance, accounting, operations, logistics, real estate, and nonprofit management.

Mansa’s professional experience includes senior financial analyst and financial controller roles, as well as leadership positions overseeing finance functions for nonprofit organizations. His work in logistics has included supply chain finance management for regional and international third-party logistics companies. He also spent more than three years serving as a fractional chief financial officer for an Indianapolis-based real estate development firm with a multimillion-dollar portfolio.

In 2020, Mansa founded MaxPoint Advisors, a CFO advisory firm serving medium-sized businesses in fast-growing industries. His consulting work focuses on financial management, strategic planning, and business growth.

Mansa is also an educator and researcher whose teaching areas have included intermediate accounting, managerial finance, risk management, corporate valuation, portfolio management, and financial economics. In 2020, he received a U.S. Department of State Fulbright Program research award for work related to financial technology.

His academic research interests include FinTech, asset management, capital structures, Islamic banking and economics, supply chain finance, microfinance, corporate governance, and investor behavior.

Mansa holds a Master of Finance with a specialization in Information Technology from Colorado State University and a Bachelor of Interdisciplinary Studies from Indiana University.

alex-lielacher.bio:
Alex Lielacher is a financial writer, content marketer, and former banker specializing in Bitcoin, blockchain, cryptocurrency, digital assets, and capital markets. He is the Founder and Managing Director of Rise Up Media, a Bitcoin-focused content marketing agency that works with cryptocurrency and blockchain companies.

Alex began his career in London on the European High Yield Trading Desk at the Royal Bank of Scotland, where he traded sub-investment-grade corporate bonds and credit default swaps. He later joined Australia & New Zealand Bank’s London office as a Fixed Income Salesperson, working with private banks, commercial banks, and mutual funds in German-speaking markets.

After more than five years in banking and capital markets, Alex transitioned into financial writing and content marketing. He has contributed to blockchain and cryptocurrency publications covering topics including real estate tokenization, token-based crowdfunding, digital asset trading strategies, Bitcoin, and broader developments in crypto finance.

Through Rise Up Media, Alex works with Bitcoin and cryptocurrency startups to develop educational and engaging content designed to communicate complex financial and technological concepts to broader audiences.

Alex has written for Imperialpedia. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Investment & Financial Risk Management from Bayes Business School, City University London.

vikki-velasquez.bio:
Vikki Velasquez is a fact-checker and researcher with experience in research, writing, editing, educational programming, and nonprofit leadership. She joined Imperialpedia as a fact-checker.

Before joining Imperialpedia, Velasquez served as Program Manager and Volunteer Coordinator at Leadership Metro Richmond, a nonprofit organization focused on developing servant leadership. In that role, she researched social and economic issues affecting the Greater Richmond community, including housing, education, wealth inequality, and historical legacy.

Her work also included researching and preparing content for presentations, publications, and educational programs; revising and editing educational materials; and developing instructional resources for program participants, board members, and facilitators. She also trained and coached volunteer instructors who delivered youth leadership programs.

Velasquez’s background in research and education provides an interdisciplinary perspective on social and economic issues and the ways they can influence individual and community outcomes.

She earned a Bachelor of Arts with honors in Gender, Sexuality, and Women’s Studies, with a minor in Religious Studies, from Virginia Commonwealth University. She also holds a volunteer management certification from The Community Foundation for a Greater Richmond.

erika-rasure.bio:
Dr. Erika Rasure is a financial therapist, educator, cryptocurrency and personal finance expert, and founder of Crypto Goddess. She has more than a decade of experience in financial education and financial therapy.

Rasure founded Crypto Goddess in 2022 as an educational platform and community designed to help women develop the knowledge and confidence to participate in cryptocurrency, blockchain, digital assets, and the evolving financial system.

Her work combines personal finance education with an understanding of the human and behavioral dimensions of financial decision-making. She has focused on helping individuals connect technical financial planning with their personal goals, values, and financial behaviors.

A longtime advocate of financial technology, Rasure incorporated FinTech topics into personal finance education, including cryptocurrency and blockchain. She also helped develop a FinTech curriculum track within the Management and Information Systems degree program at Maryville University.

As a university educator, Rasure has taught subjects related to personal finance, financial planning, and financial technology. Her work focuses on preparing individuals to understand emerging financial technologies and make informed decisions about their financial futures.

Rasure earned a Bachelor of Arts in Law, Philosophy, and Rhetoric, with a minor in Political Science, from Stephens College. She earned a Master of Science in Consumer Economics from the University of Missouri and a Ph.D. in Personal Financial Planning from Kansas State University.

cierra-murry.bio:
Cierra Murry is a financial services professional and banking compliance and credit risk specialist. She has more than 15 years of experience in financial analysis, underwriting, loan documentation, loan review, banking compliance, and credit risk management.

Throughout her career, Murry has held positions across specialty insurance, public accounting audit, financial planning and analysis, mutual fund investment services, and banking. During much of her career at a large private bank, she analyzed financial statements and tax returns, assessed credit risk for consumer, commercial, and commercial real estate loans, and evaluated compliance with banking laws and regulations.

Murry is the Founder and CEO of Murry Consulting, where she provides banking compliance, credit risk management, and loan review services to financial institutions. Her experience includes reviewing securities-based lending, premium financing, asset-based lending, cash-flow lending, small-business, middle-market, corporate, and institutional transactions.

In addition to her consulting work, Murry provides loan signing services and helps ensure that borrowers properly complete loan documentation. She also serves as a FINRA non-public arbitrator, participating in the resolution of securities-related disputes between investors and brokerage firms.

Murry earned a Bachelor of Science in Commerce, Finance, and Accounting from DePaul University.

hans-daniel-jasperson.bio:
Hans Daniel Jasperson is a fact-checker and policy researcher with more than a decade of experience providing fact-based information and analysis to business leaders, policymakers, and consumers. He has worked as a fact-checker for Imperialpedia, helping ensure the accuracy, reliability, and quality of published content.

Before joining Imperialpedia, Jasperson served as Director of Public Policy Research at Management & Training Corporation, where he prepared policy briefs and research for the U.S. Congress, federal agencies, and state policymakers. His policy work covered areas including criminal justice, education, workforce development, and career training.

Earlier in his career, Jasperson worked as a program director for Salt Lake Community Action Program, where he developed and managed nonprofit programs serving low-income communities. His work included advocating for policies and resources aimed at addressing economic inequality and improving opportunities for underserved communities.

Jasperson’s professional background combines research, public policy, government affairs, nonprofit management, workforce development, and fact-checking. His work emphasizes the importance of accurate and reliable information in supporting sound decision-making in government, business, and personal life.

Jasperson earned a Bachelor of Arts in Spanish Language and Literature and a Master of Public Administration from the University of Utah.

jonathan-ponciano.bio:
Jonathan Ponciano is a financial journalist and editor with nearly a decade of experience covering finance, markets, technology, entrepreneurship, investing, cryptocurrency, and financial technology.

Ponciano has spent several years reporting and editing stories focused on financial markets and business. His journalism has included profiling prominent executives and business leaders, including chairmen and CEOs of companies operating in emerging and technology-driven industries.

His reporting experience includes coverage of markets, finance, technology, entrepreneurship, investing, cryptocurrency, and fintech. He has also researched and calculated the net worths of some of the world’s wealthiest individuals.

Ponciano has edited articles for Imperialpedia. His work combines financial reporting with an interest in emerging technologies and the companies shaping modern markets.

Ponciano earned a dual degree in Business Journalism and Economics from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. He is currently pursuing an MBA at Columbia Business School.

gordon-scott.bio:
Gordon Scott is a financial education consultant, active investor, trader, and technical analysis specialist with more than 20 years of experience in investing, trading, and financial education. He has traded and provided education covering securities, futures, forex, and penny stocks.

Scott has more than 15 years of experience as a trading coach and has held roles in financial education, instructional design, content management, and academic instruction. He has developed educational programs designed to help individual traders and investors understand financial markets and trading strategies.

From 2013 to 2018, Scott served as Managing Director of the Chartered Market Technician (CMT) designation’s examination program for the CMT Association. The CMT designation is a recognized professional credential in technical analysis.

Scott previously served as a content manager at Investools, where he developed online curriculum and oversaw educational content related to trading strategies. He also spent 10 years with IBM, developing instructional materials and working on business process refinement, and served as an adjunct instructor in organizational strategy and leadership at Brigham Young University.

Scott is the co-author of "Invest to Win" with Toni Turner, a book covering investment approaches and the GainsMaster Investing method.

He earned a Bachelor of Arts in Technical Writing from Brigham Young University and a master’s degree in Instructional Technology from San Jose State University. He is a Chartered Market Technician (CMT) and a member of the CMT Association.

elvis-picardo.bio:
Elvis Picardo is a portfolio manager and capital markets professional with more than 25 years of experience across investment management, market strategy, and equity research. He has more than 15 years of experience as a strategist and equity analyst and currently works as a portfolio manager at iA Private Wealth.

Picardo’s areas of expertise include market analysis and investment strategy, equity research, fundamental analysis, options, portfolio management, and advanced investment strategies. He has contributed regularly to Imperialpedia and has also written for publications including The Money Letter, Investor’s Digest, Reuters.com, and Report on Mining.

His financial-market commentary and analysis have appeared through major news organizations and media outlets, including Reuters, Report on Business TV, and CBC. His work focuses on helping investors understand markets, evaluate investments, and make informed financial decisions.

Picardo earned a Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics and Communication from Karnatak University in India and a Master of Management Studies from Bombay University. He is a Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) and a Canadian Investment Manager.

james-chen.bio:
James Chen, CMT, is a financial markets professional and author. He has two decades of experience in the financial markets as a trader, investor, registered investment adviser, and global market strategist.

Chen previously served as head of research at Gain Capital and has extensive expertise across stocks, ETFs, options, commodities, fixed income, currencies, and foreign exchange. His work combines market research and technical analysis with practical experience in trading and investing.

He is the author of "Essentials of Technical Analysis for Financial Markets" and "Essentials of Foreign Exchange Trading," both published by John Wiley & Sons. He has also contributed to financial education through instructional content, seminars, and conferences.

Chen has appeared as a guest expert on financial news outlets including CNBC, Bloomberg TV, and Reuters. He is a Chartered Market Technician (CMT), Certified Financial Technician (CFTe), and Registered Investment Adviser (RIA), and is a former Commodity Trading Advisor (CTA).

Chen earned his bachelor’s degree from Tufts University.
james-chen.title: Financial Markets Professional & Author

cory-mitchell.bio:
Cory Mitchell is a professional trader, trading educator, and writer with extensive experience in day trading, swing trading, forex, currency markets, and technical analysis. He has been actively trading since 2005, focusing primarily on stocks and currencies.

Mitchell began his trading career as a proprietary trader, managing firm capital with compensation based on trading performance. After five years in proprietary trading, he transitioned to trading independently.

As a Chartered Market Technician (CMT), Mitchell specializes in short- to medium-term technical trading strategies. He has also worked with Fortune 500 companies and smaller businesses, helping them manage currency exposure and risk while identifying opportunities in foreign exchange markets.

Mitchell founded TradeThatSwing, an educational resource for day traders and swing traders. He has written extensively about financial markets and trading and has contributed to Imperialpedia, TradeThatSwing.com, and TheStreet.com/Forex. He has also delivered lectures and workshops at Canadian Society of Technical Analysts conferences and has authored trading books and educational courses.

Mitchell earned his bachelor’s degree in finance from the University of Lethbridge.

jiwon-ma.bio:
Jiwon Ma is a fact checker, editor, and research professional with experience spanning cybersecurity, international affairs, technology, geopolitical analysis, and cryptocurrency. She has worked as a fact checker for Imperialpedia since 2022 and brings more than four years of editorial experience across a range of topics and sectors.

Before joining Imperialpedia, Jiwon worked in cybersecurity and international security, including consulting for a global financial institution on cybersecurity policies. She also conducted research as a Research Analyst at the Belfer Center for Science and International Affairs, focusing on issues related to cybersecurity, international security, technology, and privacy policy.

Her professional background combines editorial expertise with research and analytical experience in technology and security. Her areas of interest include cybersecurity threat intelligence, geopolitical developments, international affairs, cryptocurrency, political economy, and the intersection of technology and public policy.

Jiwon earned a Master of International Affairs from Columbia University’s School of International and Public Affairs, concentrating in International Security Policy with specializations in Technology, Media, and Communications and East Asia Regional policies. She also earned a Bachelor of Arts degree from Lesley University.

yarilet-perez.bio:
Yarilet Perez is a fact-checker and journalist with experience in broadcast reporting, news production, editing, and financial content. She has worked as a fact-checker for Imperialpedia, helping ensure that financial information is accurate, clear, and reliable.

Yarilet began her career as a broadcast reporter, covering breaking news and politics in Washington, D.C., Chicago, and Hartford. She has prepared live newscasts, delivered breaking news, and contributed to media organizations including the Miami Herald and Univision. Her experience in journalism and financial content has strengthened her interest in personal finance, investing, and real estate.

marguerita-m-cheng.bio: Marguerita M. Cheng is the Chief Executive Officer and co-founder of Blue Ocean Global Wealth. She is a Certified Financial Planner™ professional with extensive experience in financial planning, retirement planning, personal finance, investing, and student loans. Before co-founding Blue Ocean Global Wealth, Marguerita worked as a Financial Advisor at Ameriprise Financial and as an Analyst and Editor at Towa Securities in Tokyo, Japan. She serves on the Board of Directors of the Association for Divorce Financial Planners. Marguerita is also a CFP Board Ambassador and contributes to financial education and policy discussions. She is a regular columnist for Kiplinger and has served in leadership roles with the Financial Planning Association and CFP Board.
